HLS.js 1.7.4, official ES5 UMD distribution, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/tree/v1.7.4
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.7.4/dist/hls.min.js
License: HLS-LICENSE.txt

Loaded only for HLS URLs when MediaSource is available. The app serves the
pinned local copy; no third-party CDN lookup is needed during playback.

DASH.js 4.7.4, official ES5 distribution, BSD-3-Clause.
Source: https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/tree/v4.7.4
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dashjs@4.7.4/dist/dash.all.min.js
License: DASH-LICENSE.txt

DASH retains the original manifest base URL while routing requests through
the TV header proxy. No credentials are embedded in either library.
